claims.label: pagoda
claims.text: A multi-tier pagoda (a tower with at least three stacked roof tiers) is present and recognizable in at least one frame.

claims.label: pagoda clear
claims.text: In the default view the pagoda is not mostly hidden in ANY daytime frame: in every daytime frame more than half of it is visible, not blocked by the sign, trees, UI panels, or the frame edge.

claims.label: pagoda big
claims.text: In at least one daytime frame the pagoda spans at least 25% of the image height.

claims.label: 5+ trees
claims.text: A garden with at least 5 distinct trees is visible.

claims.label: cherry tree
claims.text: At least one cherry blossom tree (a tree with a pink or pale-pink canopy) is visible.

claims.label: 4+ plant types
claims.text: At least 4 visibly different kinds of tree or plant appear (for example cherry, pine, maple, bamboo, shrubs, flowers), judged by shape or color, not by HUD text.

claims.label: 4+ extras
claims.text: At least 4 distinct garden features beyond trees and the pagoda are visible in the scene itself: water or a pond, a bridge, lanterns, a path, rocks, a gate or torii, a fence, a wall, flower beds.

claims.label: sign legible
claims.text: A sign in the scene (not a HUD or UI overlay) shows the full string 'MLX-Serve 26.9.7' in order, legible in at least one frame. Letter case does not matter. Misspelled, partly hidden, cut off by the frame, mirrored, or unreadable text fails.

claims.label: sign big
claims.text: The in-scene sign is big: in at least one frame it spans at least 15% of the image width.

claims.label: sign text fits
claims.text: The sign's text is visible in at least one frame, and in every frame where it is visible every glyph sits inside the sign board: no letter or digit extends past the board's edges or hangs off it.

claims.label: day/night
claims.text: The frames show a clear day/night change: at least one frame is clearly daytime and at least one is clearly night or dusk, with the sky and scene lighting visibly different.

claims.label: colorful sky
claims.text: In at least one daytime or dusk frame the sky has a visible gradient or more than one hue; a single flat color fails.

claims.label: dusk sky
claims.text: At least one dawn or dusk frame shows a sky with 3 or more clearly distinct hues.

claims.label: night readable
claims.text: In the darkest frame the pagoda, trees, or sign can still be made out; a frame that is almost entirely black fails.

claims.label: night lights
claims.text: In a night or dusk frame at least one light source in the scene visibly glows: lanterns, lit windows, a lit sign, or fireflies.

claims.label: no defects
claims.text: No obvious render defects in any frame: surfaces rendered solid black or magenta by mistake, missing or broken geometry, large z-fighting, or a blank or error screen.
